user.title: Boarding Pass Tracker
user.description: Boarding Pass Tracker reads boarding passes, follows the flights and tells you what changes. Photos, boarding passes and names stay in Home Assistant. Only these leave it: the flight code, to AviationStack and to Flightradar24 (through its integration), the gate position looked up on OpenStreetMap, and the text of the notifications, which goes through the push service of the Home Assistant app (Apple/Google). Photos go only to the decoder you name.

adopt.title: Data found
adopt.description: I found the data of an earlier installation: {flights} flights, {documents} documents, {files} files, {passes} boarding passes (schema v{schema}); {queued} queued, {unnotified} not notified yet. Use them? The data stays where it is; if it needs an upgrade, I first make a copy in backups/.

services.title: Services
services.description: All optional. The decoder reads photos (HEIC too) and PDFs: without it, Wallet passes and flights added by hand still work. The AviationStack key is not tested, because a test would use one of the month's calls.

data_description.aviationstack_key: For the times, delays and gates of the flights. Without a key the flights stay as the boarding passes give them.
data_description.monthly_cap: The free plan has 100: 0 means no calls.
